name: ShinMonzaemon
main_effect:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 level 5 or lower card with [Puppet] trait or with [Numemon] in its name from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
